name: PDF Reader
tagline: The PDF stays in the app. Invite a friend onto the same page — nothing is uploaded.
description:
Open a PDF and it lives inside the app. Close it, come back, you are still on the same page. It never leaves this device — not to a server, not when you send an invite.

Press Invite in the bar above and a friend lands on the page you are reading. Turn a page, they turn. Press Point, then hold a line, and a pointer appears on theirs. The file itself is not sent to a website; they are looking at the same copy, on their own device, even on a plane.

Swipe to turn pages on a phone. Pinch or tap +/− to zoom. Find jumps to every match and lights it up. A password box appears if the file needs one.

A three-page public-domain note is already open the first time, so you can try it before you pick a file of your own.

The reader is Mozilla's pdf.js, packed in. Unofficial — Mozilla did not bless this copy.
